entries.story_action: Establish the wet road, cab ignition, hands, and windshield as the emotional world.
entries.visual_media: Approved recovered storyboard frames EC-01 through EC-04 plus verified runner loops.
entries.animation_behavior: Restrained camera travel, windshield rain, practical-light breathing, and reflection continuity.
entries.lyric_cue: La ruta vibra bajo llantas cansadas … Como un recuerdo que no quiere acabar

entries.story_action: Reveal the empty passenger space and warm rest-stop details without inventing a face.
entries.visual_media: Approved recovered storyboard frames EC-05 through EC-08.
entries.animation_behavior: Localized rain, lamp flicker, steam/fog, and a slow camera drift toward the empty seat.
entries.lyric_cue: Llevo las manos vacías de promesas … Historias rotas pidiendo perdón

entries.story_action: Let the road bend into window reflection and the first memory interior.
entries.visual_media: Approved recovered storyboard frames EC-09 through EC-13 with source-verified loops.
entries.animation_behavior: Cinematic road movement paired with bounded fog, parallax, and rack focus.
entries.lyric_cue: Sigo despierto en vela y carretera … Solo quieren quedarse a existir

entries.story_action: Cross the emotional center through the descent, letter, storm, phone, and wet-road reflection.
entries.visual_media: Approved recovered storyboard frames EC-14 through EC-18 and runner FX loops.
entries.animation_behavior: Directional camera travel increases with the music; letter and storm receive calmer holds.
entries.lyric_cue: Un violín llora en casas lejanas … Pero el tiempo sabe esperar

entries.story_action: Tighten around the bend and release into the first cobalt sky.
entries.visual_media: Approved recovered storyboard frames EC-19 through EC-21.
entries.animation_behavior: Controlled push and blue-hour grade shift; preserve face, hands, and truck geometry.
entries.lyric_cue: Sigo despierto en vela y carretera … Pero igual me deja seguir

entries.story_action: Give the viewer a truthful breath in the rearview mirror and fog over water.
entries.visual_media: Approved recovered storyboard frames EC-22 and EC-23.
entries.animation_behavior: Minimal bounded fog, water shimmer, and almost imperceptible camera settle.
entries.lyric_cue: Hay ternura en este cansancio … Es la única forma de creer

entries.story_action: Move from the kept letter and tire to birds, overlook, and the driver stepping into the valley road.
entries.visual_media: Approved recovered storyboard frames EC-24 through EC-29 with full FX/transition plan.
entries.animation_behavior: Open the camera gradually from intimate memory to a wide, breathable acceptance frame.
entries.lyric_cue: No busco señales ni milagros … Y un amanecer sin preguntar

entries.story_action: Drive into day and leave the final image open, real, and unforced.
entries.visual_media: Approved recovered storyboard frame EC-30 plus final runner loop and natural light treatment.
entries.animation_behavior: Gentle forward travel with a natural light fade; no hard end card over the final lyric.
entries.lyric_cue: Sigo despierto, sigo en vela … Que sea real hasta el fin
